headline: World Player of the Week Nov 2-8, 2026: Jaime Ferrer
caption:
🏆 World Player of the Week | Nov 2–8, 2026

Jaime Ferrer, Criollos de Caguas (LBPRC) 🇵🇷

Two games, two statements. Ferrer opened his Criollos career with two home runs, only the fourth player in Puerto Rican winter league history to homer twice in his debut, and finished the week 5-for-8 with 2 HR, 4 RBI and three walks.

.625 AVG · .727 OBP · 1.500 SLG

Every week we look at every player in every league we cover and pick the one who was the best in the world. This week: 1,198 players in 5 leagues.

The shortlist:
🇲🇽 Orlando Martínez (LMP): 13-for-21, 2 HR
🇩🇴 Vidal Bruján (LIDOM): 8-for-14, 2 3B, 4 SB
🇵🇷 Isan Díaz (LBPRC): 3 HR, 9 BB
🇻🇪 René Pinto (LVBP): 8-for-18, 2 HR
🇺🇸 Zion Rose (AFL): 7 RBI, 6 SB

📸 Criollos de Caguas
